tool_args.rationale: The five paid rows cover only H<=0.48, while the target forecast is H=20.5. The supplied mechanism note explicitly predicts reversal around H=15..25, leaving material ambiguity at the target horizon. Acquire the slow-horizon discriminating probe before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit dual-exponential reversal directly from the five short-horizon observations
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All observed horizons are <=0.48, so they cannot identify long-horizon reversal parameters reliably for the target horizon 20.5.
Short-range trajectory detail does not resolve long-horizon behavior as directly as the slow-horizon probe.
It is not relevant to identifying the horizon-conditioned law.

considered_alternatives.option: Lotka–Volterra harmonic or Ricker dome models
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The supplied verified mechanism and pilot signatures favor history-conditioned dual-horizon reversal; these alternatives conflict with that evidence.
